chapter: Chicago friends: Tesch, Stacy and Wettling
title: Summer resort job with Jess Stacy near Dowagiac
summary: Between top New York bands Freeman joined Jess Stacy at a Michigan lake resort for room, board and tiny pay before a Dorsey telegram.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, Jess, there's a marvelous thing to be said for Jess. You know, in all the years, Jess and I had a job -- now, we had both been with the best bands. I was with all the top bands, Dorsey Brothers, and what not, and I would go back to Chicago every once in awhile, because I would see my dad and stay at home for awhile, and Jess had a job at a summer resort called -- it was near Dowagiac, Michigan, and I can't remember the name of the lake now -- it was on a lake and we were to play for dancing.
Jess had the job and he heard I was in town and he said, 'Come on up and we will give you your room and board and we will pick-up what we can.' I think we made about $2.50 a week apiece.

We had an absolute ball. We would play golf and baseball in the daytime and would be out in the sun all the time, having a very healthy life. We didn't really need any money, and we were playing together which was what we wanted to do.
